## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 0% | 44% (estimate, low confidence, 31.1–56.7%) | not applicable | 0% |

The Constitution is held with 4 dated versions and checks out, but every other act (17,367) is a single text as first published in the State Gazette from 2003 on, with no later amendments applied: none of the main codes is held as a current text (Criminal Code, Civil Procedure Code, Criminal Procedure Code, Obligations and Contracts Act all missing), and the one Electoral Code held is the 2011 code that the 2014 code replaced, still marked 'in force'. There is no case law, and Bulgaria has no regions that legislate.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
